CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION ... PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE ... FOR NATIONAL IS alphabet-name-2 (no MEMORY SIZE)'. Same paragraph format, but 2023 drops the MEMORY SIZE clause, allows clauses without computer-name, and adds CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION and FOR NATIONAL phrases.
